reason: I buy lighting from Wayfair, Amazon or Lowe's because I know how returns and delivery work there, and I've never heard of Nora Furnish. The UL listing, free returns and the trade discount are good, but 60 reviews on a one-person store isn't enough for me to switch when I'm watching my budget.
objection: It's a tiny store I've never heard of. If a fixture shows up damaged or the wiring doesn't match what my electrician expects, I don't know how fast one founder in Oklahoma will sort it out compared to Amazon or Wayfair.
would_change_my_mind: A trade-account price clearly below Wayfair or Amazon for the same style, plus a UL listing number I can check myself and proof that returns on a damaged fixture are handled without a fight.
